title: Billing sync: the Linked column and the same actions as the Rewst HaloPSA License Updates page
detail: Hal 2026-11-20: Billing sync needs Rewst's Linked column. Linked: the HaloPSA subscription (software license) exists and is on the recurring invoice. Not Linked: the license exists but is not on the invoice. N/A: no license exists (License ID shows None). Approving a row updates the license count; approving an N/A row creates the license (Rewst cannot add it to the invoice); Hal would like A.C.O.R.N to also add the item to the invoice and link it. Read from the Rewst workflows: the license id and link come from the recurring invoice lines (quantity_subscriptions licence_id) and /softwarelicence; a license is linked when a line carries its id; Rewst adds a line from a recurring Item with the license linked through its Add Invoice Line from Recurring Item workflow and keeps the license to item mapping in an organization variable (license_mapping_invoice_audit). Stages: (1) CORE sends each client's HaloPSA licenses (id, name, count) and which invoice lines carry which license id; the page shows License ID and Linked / Not Linked / N/A on every row. (2) Rows for tool counts that have no license at all (N/A, Halo value 0), and Approve on one creates the license (POST /softwarelicence with name and count). (3) Approve on a Not Linked or N/A row can add the line to the recurring invoice and link it, from the item chosen for that license (needs a license name to item mapping, as Rewst keeps). The license names in Rewst carry the tool and client (for example Datto SaaS Google Users - domain), set by each SaaS Billing Count workflow: each tool's naming has to be copied.
note: Stage 1 (License ID and Linked columns) and stage 2 (Approve on a row with no license and no invoice line creates the license, named like the row's Type, type 1, as Rewst's Update HaloPSA License workflow does) are live 2026-11-20. Stage 3 not started: adding the item to the recurring invoice and linking it (Rewst's license_to_halo item map and the new-line payload with quantity_subscriptions are recorded in the roadmap notes).
